text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whew... That felt great! Did ya seeme, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I think this is how I'm<n>supposed to be
runnin' these races!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I reckon we've done enough training<n>to take on the
big ones! Victory's<n>gonna be mine!

Taiki Shuttle performs amazingly well,<n>regardless of
the dirt track.

I've never doubted her abilities, but<n>this level of
growth is honestly<n>shocking!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer! Does this mean we can<n>finally go to—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
First, we celebrate our hard work with<n>some good
steak and carrot juice. ♪
